div.div: مُشْوًى , like مُهْدًى, (K, TA, [in the CK, مَشْوِىّ, like مَهْدِىّ, erroneously, as is proved by a verse cited as an ex. in the TA, pass. part. n. of 4,]) applied to a portion of a living serpent, (TA,) That has been missed by the stone [cast at it]. (K, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
